description: Test suite for the function get_azure_ad_token_provider, which creates Azure AD token provider based on environment variables. The tests cover various credential types such as ClientSecretCredential, ManagedIdentityCredential, CertificateCredential, and DefaultAzureCredential, and mock external Azure Identity SDK calls to validate correct behavior.

classes.name: TestGetAzureAdTokenProvider
classes.description: Contains unit tests for get_azure_ad_token_provider, testing different credential configurations and environment setups.
